title: wg: content-09 §3.3 MessageId sender/room URI source unspecified
description: Suggestion. §3.3 hashes senderUri and roomUri; in §4.3 the senderUri (1) and roomUri (2) extensions are optional and §4.6 says implementations only "could" determine them. Nothing says which bytes to hash when absent or which wins when present; different choices give different MessageIds, breaking replies and reactions. mimid uses the authenticated sender and room and requires present extensions to match (decision mimid-1wgh.2.10). Fix: state the source.
notes:
Verified 2026-10-18 vs -06/-09/-04 (= main): PARTLY: reference gen.py takes URIs from extensions; gaps: absent extensions, receiver check vs authenticated identity. New issue.

Filed 2026-10-18: https://github.com/ietf-wg-mimi/draft-ietf-mimi-content/issues/82
2026-11-02 reconcile: Filed as content#82 (closed); -10 §3.3 resolves the source (enclosing protocol) and adds 'extension value MUST match ... receiver MUST reject'. Remaining: no comparison rule for that match (byte-exact vs RFC 3986 §6 normalization). Unfiled.
